snippet.title: Animal Life: Eurasia Longplay [NDS] [No-Com]
snippet.description:
Educational game about animals living in Eurasia
Minigames aren't necessary but you have to do all animals' minigames on Perfect to beat the game
Have Fun :D

00:00 Beginning
00:14 Brown Bear
02:32 Eurasian Lynx
04:40 Munch
05:31 Tiger
07:57 Animal Race
09:07 Maths
09:33 Indian Python  
11:52 Orang Utan 
13:40 Ending + Credits
